attributes.name: Wei_S0
attributes.description: Weibull Formulation, Sigma0, Pa, (if negative - disabled), [Gladky2017]_

attributes.name: Wei_V0
attributes.description: Weibull Formulation, V0, m^3, representative volume, [Gladky2017]_.

attributes.name: Wei_m
attributes.description: Weibull Formulation, Weibull modulus, m, (if negative - disabled), [Gladky2017]_

attributes.name: frictionAngle
attributes.description: Contact friction angle (in radians). Hint : use 'radians(degreesValue)' in python scripts.

attributes.name: poisson
attributes.description: Poisson's ratio or the ratio between shear and normal stiffness [-]. It has different meanings depending on the Ip functor.

attributes.name: sigmaCD
attributes.description: Mohr-Coulomb failure criterium SigmaCD, Pa,  maximal compressive strength (if negative - disabled), [Gladky2017]_

attributes.name: sigmaCZ
attributes.description: Mohr-Coulomb failure criterium SigmaCZ, Pa, maximal tensile strength (if negative - disabled), [Gladky2017]_

attributes.name: strength
attributes.description: Stress at which polyhedra of volume 4/3*pi [mm] breaks.

attributes.name: strengthTau
attributes.description: Tangential stress at which polyhedra of volume 4/3*pi [mm] breaks.

attributes.name: young
attributes.description: elastic modulus [Pa]. It has different meanings depending on the Ip functor.
